companyDescription: Autonomous sidewalk delivery robots · fleet across 44 cities — but Uber, the partner the thesis was built on, has now fully exited
priceNote: Live $3.11 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Aug 13) used $4.83, a -35.6% drift over 90 days. Q3 was reported Nov 5.
summary: RESOLVED (Q3, Nov 5) — revenue of ~$2.8M (+313% y/y) beat the ~$1.7M estimate, and the guide was reportedly raised to $12M (unconfirmed in primary text). Fleet margin improved by more than 100pp q/q, and the company now serves 27 hospitals (Diligent). But the net loss is ~21x revenue, and coverage flags a sequential revenue dip and heavy burn. The stock is -36% since the Aug 13 report, and the post-Uber partnership replacement the prior report relied on is still unannounced. Base is cut to +30%. With no dated catalyst left, the report goes post-stage. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings — RESOLVED
catalysts.description: Rev ~$2.8M beat; guide reportedly $12M; heavy burn.

risks: Uber fully divested its stake — the anchor partner and demand channel behind the original thesis is gone, not merely reduced
2026 revenue guidance cut to $9-10M, and Q2 delivery volume went backwards rather than merely growing slower
Two analysts cut to $7 (Oppenheimer from $20, Guggenheim from $13) and Cantor withdrew its target entirely — the target range is now bimodal and near the current price, not above it
At a $373M cap on $9-10M of guided revenue, the multiple still prices a growth story that just stopped growing
Cash burn against a halved revenue plan makes a dilutive raise materially more likely

The prior report screened this as the best R/R on the board (17:1) purely because its stale $18.45 consensus survived a print that invalidated it — a warning about the board's inputs, not a feature of this stock

analystTargets.note: CUT from $20 after the Aug 6 print
Cut from $16 — the outlier that keeps the Moon case alive
Downgraded to Neutral and WITHDREW its price target — not a $0 target, an absence of one

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A $373M pre-scale robotics company that likely needs to raise is highly sensitive to the financing window, which is the channel rates actually work through here. But the binding constraint right now is company-specific, not macro.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE hold — the Q3 binary resolved and the stock is -36% since the last report. No dated catalyst; starter-only. Measured core at-catalyst median is -6.9% (n=54), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Not applicable going forward — the earnings catalyst already fired on Aug 6 and resolved against the thesis. The -14.5% drift since the prior report is the market repricing the guidance cut, not pre-event drift.

postWin.note: SERV's own Mar 2026 beat produced +12.3%, and SYM (Nov 2025) +14.5% as a robotics comparable. Both predate the partner exit, so they overstate what a beat is worth now.

postLose.note: SERV shed only -3% on a May 2026 disappointment, but the Aug 2026 print was a different order of magnitude — guidance halved plus partner exit — and the stock is -14.5% since. The old comparable understates the new downside.

spotSizing.reason: 1%. -36% drift, the Q3 binary resolved, and burn is heavy. Hold the starter only.

th.summary: ผ่าน catalyst แล้ว (Q3, 5 พ.ย.) — รายได้ ~$2.8M (+313% y/y) ดีกว่าคาด ~$1.7M และมีรายงานว่าปรับเป้าเป็น $12M (ยังไม่ยืนยันจากเอกสารต้นทาง) margin ของ fleet ดีขึ้นกว่า 100pp q/q และให้บริการ 27 โรงพยาบาล (Diligent) แต่ขาดทุนสุทธิ ~21 เท่าของรายได้ และมีรายงานว่ารายได้ลดลงจากไตรมาสก่อนและเผาเงินหนัก หุ้น -36% ตั้งแต่รายงาน 13 ส.ค. และพันธมิตรที่จะมาแทน Uber ตามที่รายงานก่อนคาดไว้ยังไม่ประกาศ ลด Base เป็น +30% ไม่มี catalyst ที่มีวันเหลือ รายงานจึงเข้าสู่ post-stage bias ของ Base ใน core +23.7pp เทียบ P75 14 วันจริง +6.6% Base จึงเป็นกรอบหลายสัปดาห์ ไม่ใช่คาด 14 วัน
